summary.text: Dan Noyes (Daniel Noyes) is a Democratic state representative from Lamoille-2 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Dan Noyes assumed office in the Vermont House in 2017.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments between 2017 and 2024 as the Human Services Committee and, in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, the Canvassing Committee.
